entities.name: Gutmorn
entities.description: Nightreach demon of the Devrik Depths bound in Davriel Cane's retinue, also called the Feaster Upon Souls and Tormentor of the Seven Princes.

entities.name: Davriel Cane
entities.description: Master of bound demons including Gutmorn.

entities.name: Yledris
entities.description: Gutmorn's claimed sister, a demon killed by a pyromancer's flames.

entities.name: Verlasen church
entities.description: Site of an assault by demon hunters.

events.summary: Gutmorn was wounded by a crossbow bolt defending Davriel from demon hunters at the Verlasen church.
events.quote: Gutmorn was wounded by a crossbow bolt while defending Davriel Cane from a group of demon hunters

events.summary: Yledris was killed by a pyromancer's flames and Gutmorn mourned her.
events.quote: When Yledris was killed by a pyromancer's flames, Gutmorn mourned her openly

events.summary: Gutmorn limped away with Yledris's remains to warn Davriel's household of the escaped hunters.
events.quote: Gutmorn limped away with Yledris's remains to tend his wounds

relations.note: bound demon contracted for a share of his soul
relations.quote: Gutmorn is one of Davriel Cane 's bound demons
